newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy shares hit high for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy shares hit high for 1997.

text.p: Shares of Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd hit a high for this calendar year on Thursday morning on follow-through buying after the major automaker revised up its earnings estimate for 1996/97 on Monday, traders said.
The share price briefly touched 621 yen, the highest level so far in 1997. At 0110 GMT, it stood 10 yen higher at 619.
Its volume of 5.292 million shares was the heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Fuji Heavy said on Monday it had revised up its current profit estimate for 1996/97 to 33.80 billion yen from its previous estimate of 26.00 billion. It posted current profits of 10.11 billion a year ago.
